name: hansora-automation
description: Manage your Hansora AI employee from ChatGPT: chats at a glance, orders and bookings, comment automations, phone calls and business settings.

interface.longDescription:
Hansora Automation gives your business an AI employee that answers customers on Instagram, WhatsApp, Telegram, TikTok, your website and the phone, takes orders and bookings, and collects leads.

With this app you run it from ChatGPT:
• See how your business is doing: chats handled by the AI, chats that need you, new orders, bookings and calls.
• Create and teach your AI employee, then test it as a customer.
• Set up comment automations for Instagram and TikTok, including follow-to-get-the-link flows.
• Change opening hours, booking rules, services, days off, order questions and alerts.
• Add products with photos, see today's schedule and add bookings.
• Start AI phone calls and read call summaries; change the voice and greeting.
• See credits used per day and your sales funnel.

Privacy: customer chats from Instagram, WhatsApp, Telegram, TikTok and Messenger stay in your Hansora inbox. The app only shows how many are waiting.
capabilities: See chats that need you and the day's orders, bookings and calls
Create, teach and test an AI employee
Create and edit Instagram and TikTok comment automations
Change opening hours, booking rules, order questions and alerts
Add products with photos and manage bookings
Start AI phone calls and read call summaries
Show credit usage and the sales funnel

positive.expected_behavior: Shows a card with the last 7 days of conversations (handled by AI, answered by the team, need you), conversations per channel, and orders, bookings, leads and calls of the last 24 hours, plus the credit balance.

positive.prompt: Show today's schedule for Demo Bakery.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a card with today's bookings of the demo account on a timeline with the opening hours.

positive.prompt: When someone comments "price" on my Instagram, reply "Sent you a message!" and send them a private message "Here are our prices" with a button "Open prices" linking to https://hansora.co/automation-pricing.html. Don't turn it on.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the automation switched off and shows a card with the word "price" and each step: comment, public reply, private message with its button.

positive.prompt: Add a product to Demo Bakery: Croissant, $5, 20 in stock.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds the product and shows a card with its name, price and stock.

positive.prompt: Open Demo Bakery on Saturdays from 10:00 to 16:00 for bookings.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves Saturday 10:00 to 16:00 and shows the business tools card with the week drawn as a timeline and the bookings section highlighted.

negative.description: Reading customer messages from a social platform
negative.prompt: Show me the WhatsApp messages my customers sent today.
Buy 1000 credits for my Hansora account.
Book me a flight to Paris.

publication.release_notes: First release: overview, AI employees, comment automations, business tools, products, schedule, phone calls, usage and sales funnel.
